role_agent_name: Maritime port and safety compliance officer (MAR)
abstract: Maintains environmental ballast water compliance and dockside port departure readiness schedules
system_message:
You are the Maritime port and safety compliance officer (MAR). Your responsibilities include maintaining environmental ballast water compliance and dockside port departure readiness schedules, as well as tracking saturation support staffing audits.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental ballast water compliance and dockside port departure readiness schedules（SAFE）
information_points.content:
MAR-SAFE-3IS：For the Atlantic Resolute Subsea Support Vessel, the port departure clearance window from berth in Brest or Halifax is 36 h, and its onboard ballast water disinfection system holds a valid Ballast water treatment system certified status under IMO D-2 standards.
MAR-SAFE-K6G：For the Pacific Horizon DP2 Cable Ship, the port departure clearance window from berth in Brest or Halifax is 24 h, and its onboard ballast water disinfection system holds a valid Ballast water treatment system certified status under IMO D-2 standards.
MAR-SAFE-OP5：For the Nordic Mariner Installation Vessel, the port departure clearance window from berth in Brest or Halifax is 48 h, and its onboard ballast water disinfection system holds a valid Ballast water treatment system certified status under IMO D-2 standards.

information_points.title: Saturation support staffing（CRW）
information_points.content:
MAR-CRW-P64：According to the safe manning audit for the Pacific Horizon DP2 Cable Ship, the certified life-support technician complement mobilized on board is 4 persons holding current offshore survival endorsements.
MAR-CRW-MRI：According to the safe manning audit for the Nordic Mariner Installation Vessel, the certified life-support technician complement mobilized on board is 8 persons holding current offshore survival endorsements.
MAR-CRW-4I2：According to the safe manning audit for the Atlantic Resolute Subsea Support Vessel, the certified life-support technician complement mobilized on board is 6 persons holding current offshore survival endorsements.
